chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about wheat and barley: may I purchase their crop before it produces spikes, while it is still grass?
He عليه السلام said: "No, unless he buys it as cut fodder to feed to the animals; then, if he wishes, he may leave it until it produces spikes."

key_terms.الدَّوَابَّ: the animals or beasts being fed
key_terms.الشَّعِيرِ: barley as an agricultural crop under discussion in the sale
key_terms.الْحِنْطَةِ: wheat as an agricultural crop under discussion in the sale
key_terms.حَشِيشٌ: grass or herbage before the grain has formed
key_terms.زَرْعَهُ: its cultivated crop or growth being considered for purchase
key_terms.لِقَصِيلٍ: as cut fodder intended for animal feed
key_terms.يُسَنْبِلَ: to produce spikes or ears of grain

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy wheat or barley before the crop produces spikes?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the purchase of wheat and barley before the crop has formed ears. The Imam عليه السلام prohibits such a purchase in this state unless it is bought specifically as fodder for animals, after which the buyer may leave it to continue growing if he wishes.
